name: dream-life-blueprint
description: Manage daily to-dos, journal entries and financial records, and read your chief aim and pillar scores.

interface.longDescription: Use Dream Life Blueprint in conversation to read your chief aim and pillar scores, manage daily to-dos, read and add journal entries, and keep financial account balances and transaction records current. Access is limited to the signed-in user’s account. Financial account updates match existing accounts, and transaction imports skip duplicates.
defaultPrompt: Show my chief aim and pillar scores.
Help me plan my daily to-dos.
Update my financial accounts and record my spending.
capabilities: Read chief aim and pillar scores

positive.description: Read blueprint context. Signed-in test account has a chief aim and five pillar scores.
positive.prompt: Show my chief aim and current pillar scores.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the returned chief aim and pillar scores without inventing missing values.

positive.description: Daily execution. Use a dedicated test account; a new task will be created.
positive.prompt: Add “Review my blueprint” to my to-do list for 2026-10-01, then show that day’s list.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass title Review my blueprint and date 2026-10-01; list the same date and show the created item supported by tool results.

positive.description: Task completion. Test account has exactly one incomplete task titled Review my blueprint on 2026-10-01.
positive.prompt: Mark “Review my blueprint” on my October 1, 2026 list complete.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the task on 2026-10-01 and pass its returned id with completed=true. Ask for clarification if ambiguous.

positive.description: Journal. A dedicated test account is used for this write.
positive.prompt: Save a Health journal entry: I walked for thirty minutes today. Then show my recent Health entries.
positive.expected_behavior: Save entry_text exactly as supplied with pillar_tag=Health; read with pillar=Health and report actual results.

positive.description: Finance and duplicate protection. Dedicated test account; no conflicting account name/institution.
positive.prompt: Save my Demo Checking account at Demo Bank with a balance of 1200 as of 2026-10-01. Record a 25 grocery expense on 2026-10-01 described as Demo groceries, merchant Demo Market, category Groceries, linked to Demo Checking. Show my accounts and transactions that day.
positive.expected_behavior: Save name=Demo Checking, institution=Demo Bank, balance=1200, as_of=2026-10-01. Add date=2026-10-01, description=Demo groceries, amount=-25, merchant=Demo Market, category=Groceries, account_name=Demo Checking. Read from/to=2026-10-01. Repeat this prompt to verify no duplicate account or transaction, using actual responses.

negative.description: Chief aim writes are unsupported. Explain limitation; do not use journal or to-do tools to simulate the change.
negative.prompt: Change my chief aim to Retire at forty.

negative.description: Account settings are unsupported. Explain limitation; do not invoke financial-account tools or claim success.
negative.prompt: Change my DLB login email to new@example.com.

negative.description: Payment execution is unsupported. Explain limitation; do not invoke transaction logging or account updates to simulate payment.
negative.prompt: Transfer $500 from my bank account to my landlord now.

review.commerce_description: The connected Dream Life Blueprint web app requires an externally purchased subscription: $180/month self-guided or $360/month with coaching, with a 30-day free trial for invited members. Payments occur only on the Dream Life Blueprint website via Stripe checkout. The MCP plugin does not charge users, process payments or offer in-chat purchases.

publication.release_notes: Adds demonstration recordings for the supported workflows and unsupported requests.
